message.content: Li Hua asks Jennifer Moore about adjusting the protein in her meal plan during a conversation on January 22nd, 2026, at 15:00. This discussion occurs as part of a series of interactions where Li Hua seeks advice on creating a more balanced meal plan focused on lean proteins and vegetables, given her new workout routine. In this particular conversation, Li Hua expresses her need for more protein for her workouts and mentions that she has already adjusted her meal plan to include lean meats and protein-rich snacks. Jennifer Moore provides additional suggestions and meal ideas, emphasizing the importance of protein in a balanced diet and the potential need to increase protein intake, especially post-workout.
